description: Search over 12,868 free, ready-to-copy AI prompts on fillprompt.com: image prompts (GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream and more), video prompts (Seedance, Gemini Omni, Grok Imagine and more) and text prompts (system prompts, agent prompts, roles). Returns titles, page URLs and short previews; call get_prompt for the full text.

category.description: Image category (e.g. "product-brand", "poster") or text prompt type (e.g. "agent", "developer"). See list_filters.

model.description: Only prompts written for this AI model, e.g. "Nano Banana", "Seedance", "Claude". See list_filters.

query.description: What the prompt should make, in plain words, e.g. "coffee product photo on marble" or "code review agent".

source.description: Only prompts from one open-source collection key (e.g. "hodios", "samux", "superdesign"). See list_filters text.sources.

type.description: Only image, video or text prompts.

name: search_prompts
title: Search prompts
